{{Skl|Social}} is one of the [[Skills]] available for players to level up by visiting other players private islands, or getting visited by other players. It rewards the player with additional cosmetics for their [[Private Island]], and additional commands usable on their Private Island. Social is a cosmetic-only mechanic.

Islands can have activities like a Parkour or Egg Hunt. When played, they yield the player who plays it a small amount of island points. Island points are cosmetic, and do '''not''' result in Social XP. Increasing Social levels allows the purchase of items from {{NPCSprite|Amelia}} on the Hub Island for {{C}}.

== Leveling ==
{{Sectionstub|Loudmouth Bass calculation}}
Social XP is primarily earned by people visiting the player's {{zone|Private Island}}, but can also be earned in other ways.
* Players earn {{Skill XP|10 Social}} per unique guest.
* Players earn {{Skill XP|2 Social}} per minute while guests are on their island.
* Players earn {{Skill XP|1 Social}} per minute when guesting other people's islands while the island's owner is online.
* Losing a {{Item|Loudmouth Bass}} duel. 
**Players earn {{Skill XP|1 Social}} for every {{Green|10}} lb their Loudmouth Bass had, with a minimum of {{Green|100}} and a maximum of {{Green|500,000}}.
The amount of {{Skill|Social}} XP gained is affected by [[Social Wisdom]].

== Island Activities ==
Islands can have activities like a Parkour or Egg Hunt. When played, they yield the player who plays it a small amount of island points but the island points don't give the Social XP. However, these activities may entice more guests to visit an island, increasing Social XP indirectly.

=== Parkour Blocks ===
{{Item|Parkour Start/End}} blocks, {{Item|Parkour Checkpoint}} blocks and {{Item|Parkour Times}} blocks can be purchased at Amelia in the Hub once the player reaches Social Level 1. Up to 20 {{Item|Parkour Start/End}} can be placed on an island at a given time.

The {{Item|Parkour Times}} "block" displays the fastest times in which players have completed a parkour. Up to 5 {{Item|Parkour Times}} can be placed on an island at a given time.

=== Egg Hunt ===
Island owners can place a maximum of 10 Eggs on the island to create an [[Egg Hunt]]. When visitors find all the eggs, they can earn island points.

=== Social Display ===
The Social Display is a hologram that can be placed on [[SkyBlock]] Islands, which shows the 10 players which have the most island points. It can be purchased at Amelia in the SkyBlock Hub.

== Island Ranks ==
Island ranks are custom ranks that the island owner can give to players.

Island ranks can be created through the Island Management Settings within the [[SkyBlock Menu]]. The command /islandrank can also be used.

Island ranks cannot be used to set permissions.

== Social Games ==
There are two types of social games, social commands, and actual social games. Social commands are commands that the player can use on their island to play "games" with other players. The social games are items that one player can use on another to challenge them to a game of the specified item. The social games are [[Rock Paper Shears]], [[Four in a Row]], and [[Tic Tac Toe]].

== Island Naming ==
This lets the island owner name their island. This is useful for providing a description of the island.
